name: gleech
description: Universal image glitching and 3-bit dithering engine for Node.js and browser canvas (fork of Glitchy3bitDither)

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll', ''); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', {recursive:true});"
scripts.lint: node --check index.js bin/gleech src/main.js src/core/gleech-engine.js src/core/canvas-utils.js src/core/databend.js src/core/algorithm-params.js src/workers/gleech.worker.js src/workers/worker-pool.js
scripts.test: node --check index.js && node ./bin/gleech list && node test/test.js && node test/test-rig.js
